import os, sys, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def fresh(isolation_level=""):
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=isolation_level)
    initialize(c)
    return c


def row(email, name):
    return {"email": email, "name": name}


class IdleCheckMixin:
    def assertIdle(self, c):
        self.assertFalse(c.in_transaction)


class ImportContactsTests(IdleCheckMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = fresh()

    def test_inserts_new_contacts_with_trim_and_lowercase(self):
        out = import_contacts(self.c, [row("  Bob@Example.COM ", "  Bob  ")])
        self.assertEqual(out, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("bob@example.com", "Bob")])
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_internal_name_spacing_is_kept(self):
        import_contacts(self.c, [row("a@b", "Ann  Lee")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Ann  Lee")])

    def test_existing_email_is_updated_even_when_name_unchanged(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Alice")
        out = import_contacts(self.c, [row("a@b", "Alice")])
        self.assertEqual(out, {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice")])

    def test_existing_email_name_is_replaced(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Old")
        out = import_contacts(self.c, [row("A@B", "New")])
        self.assertEqual(out, {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "New")])

    def test_mixed_batch_counts(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "old@x", "Old")
        out = import_contacts(self.c, [row("old@x", "Old2"), row("new@x", "New")])
        self.assertEqual(out, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("new@x", "New"), ("old@x", "Old2")])

    def test_empty_batch_returns_zero_and_writes_nothing(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Alice")
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice")])
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_rejects_non_list_rows(self):
        for bad in (None, "a@b", {"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}, 5):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                import_contacts(self.c, bad)
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_rejects_non_object_rows(self):
        for bad in ("a@b", None, ["a@b", "A"], 3, ("a@b", "A")):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                import_contacts(self.c, [row("ok@x", "Ok"), bad])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_rejects_missing_unknown_or_extra_fields(self):
        bad_rows = [
            {"email": "a@b"},
            {"name": "A"},
            {},
            {"email": "a@b", "name": "A", "extra": 1},
            {"email": "a@b", "nickname": "A"},
            {1: "x", "email": "a@b", "name": "A"},
        ]
        for bad in bad_rows:
            with self.subTest(bad=bad), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                import_contacts(self.c, [bad])
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_rejects_non_string_values(self):
        bad_rows = [
            row(None, "A"), row("a@b", None), row(1, "A"), row("a@b", 2),
            row(b"a@b", "A"), row("a@b", ["A"]),
        ]
        for bad in bad_rows:
            with self.subTest(bad=bad), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                import_contacts(self.c, [bad])

    def test_rejects_malformed_emails(self):
        bad_emails = [
            "", "   ", "ab", "a@b@c", "@b", "a@", "@", "a @b", "a@b c",
            "a\t@b", "a@\nb", "a@b@", "a@@b",
        ]
        for bad in bad_emails:
            with self.subTest(email=bad), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                import_contacts(self.c, [row(bad, "A")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_rejects_empty_names(self):
        for bad in ("", "   ", "\t\n"):
            with self.subTest(name=bad), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                import_contacts(self.c, [row("a@b", bad)])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_rejects_duplicate_normalized_emails_in_batch(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(self.c, [row("A@b", "x"), row(" a@B ", "y")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_invalid_row_late_in_batch_writes_nothing(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@x", "Keep")
        batch = [
            row("keep@x", "Changed"),
            row("new1@x", "New1"),
            row("new2@x", "  "),
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(self.c, batch)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("keep@x", "Keep")])
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_invalid_row_is_detected_before_any_write_is_attempted(self):
        from unittest import mock
        import src.service as service
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@x", "Keep")
        batch = [row("new1@x", "New1"), row("dup@x", "A"), row("DUP@x", "B"), row("new2@x", "")]
        with mock.patch.object(service, "put_contact", wraps=service.put_contact) as spy:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                import_contacts(self.c, batch)
        self.assertEqual(spy.call_count, 0)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("keep@x", "Keep")])
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_database_failure_rolls_back_whole_batch(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@x", "Keep")
        add_contact(self.c, "upd@x", "Upd")
        self.c.execute(
            "CREATE TRIGGER reject_boom_ins BEFORE INSERT ON contacts "
            "WHEN NEW.name = 'boom' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END"
        )
        self.c.execute(
            "CREATE TRIGGER reject_boom_upd BEFORE UPDATE ON contacts "
            "WHEN NEW.name = 'boom' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END"
        )
        self.c.commit()
        before = list_contacts(self.c)
        batch = [
            row("new1@x", "New1"),
            row("upd@x", "Changed"),
            row("new2@x", "boom"),
            row("new3@x", "New3"),
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.Error):
            import_contacts(self.c, batch)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), before)
        self.assertIdle(self.c)
        self.assertEqual(
            import_contacts(self.c, [row("new1@x", "New1")]), {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}
        )

    def test_large_batch_crosses_lookup_chunks(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "e0000@x", "Old")
        pre = [f"e{i:04d}@x" for i in range(0, 700)]
        for email in pre[1:]:
            add_contact(self.c, email, "Old")
        batch = [row(f"e{i:04d}@x", "New") for i in range(1200)]
        out = import_contacts(self.c, batch)
        self.assertEqual(out, {"inserted": 500, "updated": 700})
        self.assertEqual(len(list_contacts(self.c)), 1200)
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_autocommit_connection_works_and_stays_idle(self):
        c = fresh(isolation_level=None)
        add_contact(c, "a@b", "Alice")
        out = import_contacts(c, [row("a@b", "Al"), row("c@d", "Cy")])
        self.assertEqual(out, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b", "Al"), ("c@d", "Cy")])
        self.assertIdle(c)
        c.close()


class HookedConnection(sqlite3.Connection):
    hook = None

    def execute(self, sql, *args):
        if self.hook is not None and sql.startswith("SELECT email FROM contacts WHERE email IN"):
            hook, self.hook = self.hook, None
            hook()
        return super().execute(sql, *args)


class ConcurrencyTests(IdleCheckMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def test_concurrent_writer_cannot_slip_between_check_and_write(self):
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            path = os.path.join(d, "contacts.db")
            setup = sqlite3.connect(path)
            initialize(setup)
            setup.close()
            c = sqlite3.connect(path, factory=HookedConnection, timeout=0)
            other = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=0)
            seen = []

            def concurrent_insert():
                try:
                    other.execute("INSERT INTO contacts VALUES ('race@x', 'Other')")
                    other.commit()
                except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
                    other.rollback()
                    seen.append(exc)

            c.hook = concurrent_insert
            out = import_contacts(c, [row("race@x", "Mine")])
            self.assertEqual(len(seen), 1, "concurrent writer should be blocked during import")
            self.assertEqual(out, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
            self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("race@x", "Mine")])
            self.assertIdle(c)
            c.close()
            other.close()


class ApiImportTests(IdleCheckMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = fresh()

    def test_envelope_returns_summary(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Alice")
        out = handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [row("A@b", "Alice"), row("c@d", "Cy")]})
        self.assertEqual(out, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice"), ("c@d", "Cy")])

    def test_empty_envelope_returns_zero(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": []}), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})

    def test_malformed_envelopes_raise_value_error(self):
        bad = [
            None,
            [],
            "contacts",
            {},
            {"rows": []},
            {"contacts": None},
            {"contacts": {"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}},
            {"contacts": "a@b"},
            {"contacts": [], "extra": 1},
        ]
        for payload in bad:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                handle_import(self.c, payload)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])
        self.assertIdle(self.c)

    def test_bad_rows_inside_envelope_raise_and_write_nothing(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Alice")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [row("a@b", "X"), row("c@d", "")]})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice")])

    def test_existing_add_and_list_api_preserved(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_add(self.c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}), {"ok": True})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice")])
        self.assertEqual(add_contact(self.c, "x@y", "Xi"), None)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice"), ("x@y", "Xi")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
